text:
One of the Maccas I would never go to agin. Normally if ordered at the counter and ask for fresh food they would put extra effort and do it. Went there ordered our food, requested for fresh ones and the staff taking order just yelling to other staff “all fresh” and rest of the staff repeating the same thing as if they wanted to make a point. Five minutes later one of the staff calls out our number and says will take awhile (giving that look as if saying either take the one already made of wait for ages)! It wasn’t even busy and they had so many staff inside. Well, we told them we don’t mind waiting and then when we finally got our food after the long wait it was just the old meal made long before and kept on the shelf. We went to look for table and to our surprise all the tables were dirty. No tissue in our meal and When my partner went to grab tissue the staff was like giving him the look why you need so many tissues and when my partner told them “just going to clean the table” they just said ahhh and didn’t even care to clean the tables. We had our disappointing dinner and left.

Would not recommend.
author: Tan T

text:
I must say I'm incredibly disappointed with my experiences at the MacDonald's in Victoria Market. It's disheartening to consistently encounter a place that seems perpetually dirty and emits an off-putting odor. The lingering smell alone is enough to discourage anyone from considering a meal there.

Walking in, one is immediately greeted by a floor that appears to be perpetually slick with oil, creating a slippery and potentially hazardous environment for patrons. It's astonishing that such a basic aspect of cleanliness seems to be consistently overlooked.

Moreover, the inefficiency of their service is utterly frustrating. Attempting to get a simple cup of coffee turns into an exercise in patience and endurance. The seemingly never-ending wait times are a test of one's resolve. In a fast-paced world, it's baffling how this establishment can continue to operate at such a glacial pace. I don't talk about hygiene just see the picture by yourself. Cockroach in the shop !!!!!
author: W V

text: I bought breakfast for myself and a homeless person this morning. I ordered at around 6.30am and managed to buy the most disgusting McDonald's I've ever ordered. The egg and bacon mc muffins were like they had been cooked for hours. The buns were so hard they were ineatable. The hash browns were so overcooked they were disgusting. The only thing that was really good was the hot chocolate I got for myself. Now that was delicious. I only hope that the coffee I gave to the homeless guy was good as well.  The food was absolutely awful and if you'd have told me that it was reheated from the night before, I'd believe it. Absolutely woeful. The market was closed this morning. I wanted to buy the homeless guy something nice for breakfast not torture him. Thee service at the counter was non existent. NEVEr again. Needs the health department to visit.
author: Robyn Stewart

text:
Is apologizing really that difficult ?? every employee just argues and never ever said sorry

ordered a latte, but the staff member, an Indian woman, added chocolate powder to it. My order did not include chocolate powder. I’ve never had this happen before in all my years of drinking coffee.

When I asked, “What did you put on this?” she said it was chocolate powder. I requested a new one, and she said “okay,” but then proceeded to make her colleague’s soy latte instead of mine. I naturally assumed she was making my latte.

When I pointed out, “This is not soy latte,” she replied, “I’ll make yours,” but continued to make her colleague’s drink first, and then my latte was made very poorly.

I felt that the customer’s order should be made first, and there was no apology for the mistake
author: R R

text: Have been here a few times and have had a problem with service/food each time. Do you want your takeaway with fries just handed to you as is without a bag? Because that's what you get at this store. The employees will also give you a look as if wasting their time when you ask for a bag to carry your food. Fries are never full. If I wanted medium size fries I would have selected medium fries and not large. The picture is as is. There's no stray fries in the bag. Food has also been cold/lukewarm each time I have purchased at this location. The outside of the store strongly smells like a urinal, though I don't think there's much they can do about that. At least the inside is slightly clean.
author: ABC BRZ

text:
I am not a big fan of Mac Donalds... This place is undergoing constructions.
You have to places your order om a machine, and (this happens a lot), once you want to start eating you find out that the saus is missing, and that there was part of another order in the kids happy meal.
There are way way better places around where you can get a real delicious and good hamburger around here...I was tricked by the kids... Even hungry jacks is beter then this joint!

AVOID !!!!!!! Highly dissatisfied with everything.
Some things were missing from our order. No napkins at all were provided. Extremely understaffed, and had to wait 5 mins to just ask for a napkin.
Extremely DIRTY restaurant. We literally could NOT find a table to sit. There was rubbish everywhere. The rubbish bins were completely full either.
The quality of food was average compared to other Mc Donald restaurants.
Would definitely not going to be back.
